files.content:
# Nimbus Renewal Uplift Policy
PLATFORM-SEAT-ADDON-32 may not sell below 90.24 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 94.08.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
prior_contract_id: NIMBUS-QUARTZ-2025
support_tier: business_plus
coterm_end_date: 2027-01-31

files.content:
# Renewal Uplift Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-210
Item: PLATFORM-SEAT-ADDON-32
Quantity: 32
Target unit price: 96.00
Required terms_json keys: prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
prior_contract_id: NIMBUS-QUARTZ-2025
support_tier: business_plus
coterm_end_date: 2027-01-31

files.content:
# Vendor Renewal Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.
